newsitem.title: USA: Litton unit gets $50 million contract.
newsitem.headline: Litton unit gets $50 million contract.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc said its Guidance & Control Systems division has been awarded a contract by the U.S. Navy to provide replacement navigation systems for all of the service's four-engine P-3 and C-130 patrol and cargo-type aircraft.

Production options for up to 784 systems to be delivered over the next five years could bring the total contract value to Litton to more than $50 million. Production will be carried on at the Litton division's plant in Salt Lake City.
The systems will be direct replacements for existing Litton units aboard the aircraft since the late 1970s. Two systems are installed in each aircraft.
